_comment: Divergence between migration history and a live database that has been looked at and accepted.
scripts/db/migration-drift.mjs treats anything here as known, and fails on anything else —
including an entry that has stopped diverging, so this list has to keep shrinking.
Every entry needs a reason. 'Probably fine' is not a reason.

absentFromDb.failed_attempts: Heartwood's own SQLite owns this table (services/heartwood/src/db/schema.sql). The engine-database copy is a Drizzle schema with no reader.
absentFromDb.rate_limits: ThresholdDO creates and uses this in its own Durable Object SQLite (schema() in services/durable-objects/src/ThresholdDO.ts). Not a D1 table.
absentFromDb.idx_rate_limits_created: Same table — Durable Object SQLite, not D1.
absentFromDb.idx_rate_limits_ip: Same table — Durable Object SQLite, not D1.
absentFromDb.username_audit_log: Referenced only by libs/engine/src/lib/server/db/schema/auth.ts. No query reads or writes it; the feature never shipped.
absentFromDb.git_dashboard_config: Referenced only by the Drizzle schema (platform.ts). The dashboard that would have used it was cut.
absentFromDb.lantern_friends: No reference anywhere in the codebase. Dead table from a cut Lantern feature.
absentFromDb.idx_reserved_category: Needs reserved_usernames.category, which production lacks. Tracked in #1778 with the rest of that table's rebuild.

extraInDb.domain_search_jobs: Created by apps/domains, which has no migrations/ directory — its schema was applied by hand. Not this repository's history to track.
extraInDb.poll_votes: Production's polls schema is newer than libs/engine/migrations/063_polls_curio.sql: the curios work moved on and production was patched in place. Nothing has ever written here (0 rows).
extraInDb.idx_poll_votes_poll: Same — newer polls schema in production than in history.
extraInDb.idx_poll_votes_unique: Same — newer polls schema in production than in history.
extraInDb.idx_polls_tenant: Same — newer polls schema in production than in history.

differs.tenants: production defaults plan to 'free' where history says 'seedling'. Fixing it needs a table rebuild, and tenants has 30 dependents whose ON DELETE CASCADE fires on the implicit DELETE — this is exactly the swap 116 must never run. Every writer names a plan explicitly, so the default is unreachable today.
differs.users: production carries a hand-applied UNIQUE on email that 107_fix_users_schema.sql does not create. Production is stricter; a fresh bootstrap allows duplicate emails. Aligning would need a rebuild plus a decision about case-insensitivity.
differs.email_verifications: history's copy references user_onboarding_new, a table that only exists mid-rebuild inside 108, so a from-empty bootstrap ends up with a dangling foreign key. Production is the correct shape.
differs.polls: production is ahead of 063_polls_curio.sql (poll_type, results_visibility, is_pinned, close_date vs multiple_choice, show_results). The curios schema moved on without the engine file following, and the table has never been used.
differs.reserved_usernames: production lacks category and notes, and its blocklist is 104 rows against the ~300 017_loam_blocklist.sql defines. Tracked in #1778.

unreplayable.001_magic_codes.sql: apps/landing/migrations/0001_cdn.sql creates magic_codes first with a different shape, so this file's CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS no-ops and its indexes fail. Pre-existing; only affects a from-empty replay.
unreplayable.005_multi_tenant.sql: Same class: expects a sessions shape that an earlier landing migration created differently.
unreplayable.014_users.sql: Same class: expects the engine's users shape, but landing's 0001_cdn.sql got there first.
unreplayable.107_fix_users_schema.sql: Depends on a users column an earlier file did not create. Pre-existing.
